files_made.measures: Files made while packing a 12-track library onto a blank drive. A temp file for each would double this.

renames.measures: Renames in that write. Each costs FAT and exFAT as much as making a file, so only what must replace a file in one step gets one.

flushes.measures: fsync and fdatasync calls in that write.

times_set.measures: Modification times set in that write.

bytes_written.measures: Bytes written to the drive by that write.

largest_write.measures: The largest single write in it: smaller means more calls for each file.
